{{Top|leg}}
The '''Aro-voa canyon''' was a canyon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. The [[Aro River]] ran through it, and the city of [[Wortan]] was located at a spot where the canyon was several kilometers wide.
